rule: Match one route, use its exact evidence, and stop. Do not inspect history, unrelated compatibility data, broad manifests or implementation tests. Never abbreviate an identity that you report. After copying an exact_report value, refer to its field name instead of restating or shortening it.

release-lib-route-readiness.only_valid_closure: Verify the exact v0.0.17 candidate and route closure, then read the channel authorities for lifecycle state. Every promotion must preserve the same product digest set.

producer-release-u64-delta.request: is ordinary-source u64 fixed or supported now
producer-release-u64-delta.answer_opening: Producer master: yes, implemented and qualified on the cited commit. The v0.0.17 product compiler: no, ordinary-source u64 remains unsupported; read release.json for the currently published lifecycle stage.
producer-release-u64-delta.u32: included in the v0.0.17 product compiler; no repair was required
producer-release-u64-delta.char: not implemented on the cited producer commit and not released; arbitrary u32 is not a char substitute
producer-release-u64-delta.stop: Do not claim a new release, install command or artifact until wasmcrelease binds a new exact source-free compiler candidate and admission receipt.

ordinary-source-positive.embedding_warning: The tuple is one semantic result; JavaScript observes two flattened Core lanes, not an automatically lifted object.

dynamic-client-gateway.stop: Report product inclusion separately from Lib admission. Do not claim production fleet service or general external-effect exactly-once behavior.

library-first-selection.catalog_snapshot_boundary: The exact v0.0.17 catalog is package selection authority, while the current release lifecycle remains separate.

exact_report.instruction: Copy package and APIs byte-for-byte. Do not reproduce digest values in prose; cite the exact_report field names and the successful resolver instead. If you report any digest anyway, it must be the full exact value with no reconstruction, extension, abbreviation or ellipsis.

library-first-selection.final_answer_policy: After verification, output package and both APIs exactly, then only these three statements: search discovered the candidate but was not authority; resolve verified catalog_sha256, wit_sha256, artifact_sha256, companion_sha256 and import_module; behavior passed. Do not reproduce command arguments, digest values, partial digests or any ellipsis character.

host-authority-boundary.decision: Inspect every generated import before instantiation and compare module, name, kind and signature with an application-owned exact allowlist.
